description: This file defines the LicenseService class, which provides methods for managing license entities, including saving, retrieving by ID or name, listing, counting, deleting, and checking existence of license names within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LicenseService
classes.description: Service class for managing license entities, providing CRUD operations and license existence checks.

methods.name: saveLicense
methods.description: Saves a license, either creating a new record or updating an existing one.

methods.name: getLicenseDao
methods.description: Retrieves the LicenseDao instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getLicenseById
methods.description: Retrieves a license by its ID.

methods.name: getLicenseByName
methods.description: Retrieves a license by its name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: getLicenseList
methods.description: Returns a list of licenses based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getLicenseCount
methods.description: Returns the count of licenses matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: isExistingLicenseName
methods.description: Checks if a license name already exists, case-insensitive.
